lines.thinice: THE ICE CRACKS UNDER YOU  KEEP ROLLING  LAST ONE UP WINS

lines.paint: ROLL TO PAINT THE FLOOR  BURST PAINT BOMBS  THE MOST FLOOR WINS

lines.chute: UP THE BELT TO THE LINE  DODGE THE FRUIT ROLLING DOWN

lines.hoops: ROLL THROUGH THE HOOPS  HOP THE HIGH ONES  GOLD PAYS 3

lines.cannon: CANNONS FIRE DOWN THE RED STRIPES  GET OUT OF THE LANES

lines.glass: HOP PANEL TO PANEL  OF EACH PAIR ONE HOLDS AND ONE SHATTERS
lines.gates: TIME YOUR RUN  A FLASHING GATE IS ABOUT TO SLAM DOWN
lines.stomp: DODGE THE STOMPERS CHARGING DOWN THEIR PATHS  HOP THE SHOCKWAVES
lines.seesaw: THE PLANKS TIP UNDER YOUR WEIGHT  STAY HIGH  LAST ONE ON WINS

lines.balloon: STOMP OR RAM THE OTHERS TO POP THEIR BALLOONS  KEEP YOURS
